/*
 * Deterministic demo data. The same counts always produce the same rows,
 * so tests can check exact totals. Kept free of version-specific code so
 * it runs unchanged on PHP 7.2 through 8.3.
 */

final class SeedRandom
{
    private $state;

    public function __construct($seed)
    {
        $this->state = $seed;
    }

    /** Integer between $min and $max inclusive (a plain LCG, the same on every PHP version). */
    public function between($min, $max)
    {
        $this->state = ($this->state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483648;
        return $min + ($this->state % ($max - $min + 1));
    }

    public function pick(array $items)
    {
        return $items[$this->between(0, count($items) - 1)];
    }
}

function seed_database(PDO $pdo, $orderCount = 5000, $customerCount = 500, $productCount = 120)
{
    $r = new SeedRandom(20170615);
    $first = array('Amira', 'Ben', 'Chloe', 'Dmitri', 'Elena', 'Farid', 'Grace', 'Hiro', 'Ines', 'Jonas', 'Kofi', 'Lena', 'Mateo', 'Nadia', 'Omar', 'Priya', 'Quinn', 'Rosa', 'Sven', 'Tariq', 'Uma', 'Victor', 'Wen', 'Yara', 'Zane');
    $last = array('Adams', 'Baker', 'Costa', 'Diaz', 'Evans', 'Fischer', 'Garcia', 'Haddad', 'Ito', 'Jensen', 'Khan', 'Lopez', 'Moreau', 'Novak', 'Okafor', 'Petrov', 'Reyes', 'Sato', 'Tanaka', 'Weber');
    $companies = array('Acorn Labs', 'Bluefin Retail', 'Cedar & Co', 'Delta Freight', 'Ember Studio', 'Fjord Foods', 'Granite Works', 'Harbor Health', null, null);
    $cities = array('Leeds', 'Lyon', 'Austin', 'Porto', 'Karachi', 'Osaka', 'Denver', 'Gdansk', 'Nairobi', 'Toronto');
    $items = array('Paper, A4 ream', 'Toner cartridge', 'Desk lamp', 'Office chair', 'USB-C cable', 'Label printer', 'Whiteboard', 'Shipping boxes (25)', 'Packing tape', 'Monitor arm', 'Notebook pack', 'Stapler');
    $statuses = array('paid', 'paid', 'paid', 'open', 'open', 'void');

    $pdo->beginTransaction();

    $stmt = $pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, name, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)');
    $stmt->execute(array('admin@example.com', password_hash('secret', PASSWORD_DEFAULT), 'Admin', '2017-01-01 09:00:00'));

    $rows = array();
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $customerCount; $i++) {
        $name = $r->pick($first) . ' ' . $r->pick($last);
        $email = strtolower(str_replace(' ', '.', $name)) . $i . '@example.com';
        $notes = $r->between(1, 5) === 1 ? 'Prefers invoices by post.' : null;
        $rows[] = array($name, $email, $r->pick($companies), $r->pick($cities), $notes, sprintf('2017-%02d-%02d 10:00:00', $r->between(1, 12), $r->between(1, 28)));
    }
    insert_many($pdo, 'customers', array('name', 'email', 'company', 'city', 'notes', 'created_at'), $rows);

    $rows = array();
    $prices = array();
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $productCount; $i++) {
        $price = $r->between(199, 49999) / 100;
        $prices[$i] = $price;
        $rows[] = array(sprintf('SKU-%04d', $i), $r->pick($items) . ' #' . $i, $price, $r->between(1, 10) === 1 ? 0 : 1);
    }
    insert_many($pdo, 'products', array('sku', 'name', 'unit_price', 'active'), $rows);

    $orders = array();
    $lines = array();
    $taxRates = array(0, 5, 10, 20);
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $orderCount; $i++) {
        $day = $r->between(0, 1094);
        $created = date('Y-m-d H:i:s', strtotime('2017-01-01 08:00:00 UTC') + $day * 86400 + $r->between(0, 36000));
        $notes = $r->between(1, 8) === 1 ? 'Deliver to the back entrance.' : null;
        $orders[] = array($r->between(1, $customerCount), $r->pick($statuses), $r->pick($taxRates), $notes, $created);
        $lineCount = $r->between(1, 4);
        for ($l = 0; $l < $lineCount; $l++) {
            $pid = $r->between(1, $productCount);
            $lines[] = array($i, $pid, sprintf('SKU-%04d', $pid), 'Item ' . sprintf('SKU-%04d', $pid), $r->between(1, 12), $prices[$pid]);
        }
    }
    insert_many($pdo, 'orders', array('customer_id', 'status', 'tax_rate', 'notes', 'created_at'), $orders);
    insert_many($pdo, 'order_lines', array('order_id', 'product_id', 'sku', 'description', 'qty', 'unit_price'), $lines);

    $pdo->commit();
    return array('customers' => $customerCount, 'products' => $productCount, 'orders' => $orderCount, 'lines' => count($lines));
}

function insert_many(PDO $pdo, $table, array $columns, array $rows)
{
    foreach (array_chunk($rows, 500) as $chunk) {
        $placeholders = '(' . implode(', ', array_fill(0, count($columns), '?')) . ')';
        $sql = 'INSERT INTO ' . $table . ' (' . implode(', ', $columns) . ') VALUES ' . implode(', ', array_fill(0, count($chunk), $placeholders));
        $values = array();
        foreach ($chunk as $row) {
            foreach ($row as $v) {
                $values[] = $v;
            }
        }
        $pdo->prepare($sql)->execute($values);
    }
}

/*
 * Create (or recreate) the database, load the schema, run migrations and seed it.
 *
 *   php db/setup.php                 5,000 orders, the demo size
 *   php db/setup.php --orders=60     a small set, used by the tests
 *   DB_NAME=invoicer_test php db/setup.php --orders=60 --customers=25 --products=15
 */
require __DIR__ . '/seed.php';

$opts = getopt('', array('orders::', 'customers::', 'products::'));
$c = require __DIR__ . '/../config/config.php';

$pdo = new PDO('mysql:host=' . $c['db_host'] . ';port=' . $c['db_port'] . ';charset=utf8mb4', $c['db_user'], $c['db_pass'], array(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION));
$pdo->exec('DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS `' . $c['db_name'] . '`');
$pdo->exec('CREATE DATABASE `' . $c['db_name'] . '` CHARACTER SET utf8mb4');
$pdo->exec('USE `' . $c['db_name'] . '`');

$sql = file_get_contents(__DIR__ . '/schema.sql');
$migrations = glob(__DIR__ . '/migrations/*.sql');
sort($migrations);
foreach ($migrations as $m) {
    $sql .= "\n" . file_get_contents($m);
}
foreach (array_filter(array_map('trim', explode(';', preg_replace('/^--.*$/m', '', $sql)))) as $statement) {
    $pdo->exec($statement);
}

$counts = seed_database(
    $pdo,
    isset($opts['orders']) ? (int) $opts['orders'] : 5000,
    isset($opts['customers']) ? (int) $opts['customers'] : 500,
    isset($opts['products']) ? (int) $opts['products'] : 120
);

fwrite(STDERR, sprintf("Database %s ready: %d customers, %d products, %d orders, %d order lines, %d migration(s).\n", $c['db_name'], $counts['customers'], $counts['products'], $counts['orders'], $counts['lines'], count($migrations)));

class Order
{
    public $id;
    public $customer_id;
    public $status;
    public $tax_rate;
    public $created_at;

    public static function fromRow(array $row)
    {
        $order = new Order();
        $order->id = (int) $row['id'];
        $order->customer_id = (int) $row['customer_id'];
        $order->status = $row['status'];
        $order->tax_rate = $row['tax_rate'];
        $order->created_at = $row['created_at'];
        return $order;
    }

    public function label()
    {
        return invoice_number($this->id) . ' (' . status_label($this->status) . ')';
    }
}

/**
 * A list of Order objects you can foreach over and count().
 */
class OrderCollection implements Iterator, Countable
{
    private $orders = array();
    private $position = 0;

    public function __construct(array $orders)
    {
        $this->orders = array_values($orders);
    }

    public function current()
    {
        return $this->orders[$this->position];
    }

    public function key()
    {
        return $this->position;
    }

    public function next()
    {
        $this->position++;
    }

    public function rewind()
    {
        $this->position = 0;
    }

    public function valid()
    {
        return isset($this->orders[$this->position]);
    }

    public function count()
    {
        return count($this->orders);
    }

    public function totalValue()
    {
        $sum = 0;
        foreach ($this->orders as $order) {
            $sum += $order->total;
        }
        return $sum;
    }
}

class OrderRepository
{
    /**
     * Most recent orders, with the customer name and total filled in.
     *
     * @return OrderCollection
     */
    public function recent($limit)
    {
        $rows = db_all('SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ' . (int) $limit);
        $orders = array();
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $order = Order::fromRow($row);
            $customer = db_one('SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id = ?', array($order->customer_id));
            $order->customer_name = $customer['name'];
            $order->lines = $this->lines($order->id);
            $totals = calculate_totals($order->lines, $order->tax_rate);
            $order->total = $totals['total'];
            $orders[] = $order;
        }
        return new OrderCollection($orders);
    }

    public function find($id)
    {
        $row = db_one('SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id = ?', array($id));
        if (!$row) {
            return null;
        }
        $order = Order::fromRow($row);
        $order->notes = $row['notes'];
        $order->customer = db_one('SELECT * FROM customers WHERE id = ?', array($order->customer_id));
        $order->lines = $this->lines($order->id);
        return $order;
    }

    public function lines($orderId)
    {
        return db_all('SELECT * FROM order_lines WHERE order_id = ? ORDER BY id', array($orderId));
    }
}

/**
 * Shared PDO connection.
 *
 * @return PDO
 */
function db()
{
    static $pdo = null;
    if ($pdo === null) {
        $c = $GLOBALS['config'];
        $dsn = 'mysql:host=' . $c['db_host'] . ';port=' . $c['db_port'] . ';dbname=' . $c['db_name'] . ';charset=utf8mb4';
        $pdo = new PDO($dsn, $c['db_user'], $c['db_pass'], array(
            PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
            PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
        ));
    }
    return $pdo;
}

function db_one($sql, $params = array())
{
    $stmt = db()->prepare($sql);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    return $stmt->fetch();
}

function db_all($sql, $params = array())
{
    $stmt = db()->prepare($sql);
    $stmt->execute($params);
    return $stmt->fetchAll();
}

/**
 * Escape text for HTML output.
 */
function h($text)
{
    static $escaper = null;
    if ($escaper === null) {
        $escaper = new Zend\Escaper\Escaper('utf-8');
    }
    return $escaper->escapeHtml($text);
}

/**
 * Format an amount of money, e.g. money(12.5, 'USD', 2) => "$12.50".
 */
function money($amount, $currency = 'USD', $decimals)
{
    $symbols = array('USD' => '$', 'EUR' => '€', 'GBP' => '£');
    $symbol = isset($symbols[$currency]) ? $symbols[$currency] : $currency . ' ';
    return $symbol . number_format($amount, $decimals);
}

/**
 * Build "?a=1&b=2" from an array, skipping empty values.
 */
function build_query($params)
{
    $parts = array();
    reset($params);
    while (list($key, $value) = each($params)) {
        if ($value === null || $value === '') {
            continue;
        }
        $parts[] = urlencode($key) . '=' . urlencode($value);
    }
    return $parts ? '?' . implode('&', $parts) : '';
}

/**
 * Work out invoice totals from order lines.
 *
 * Each line needs 'qty' and 'unit_price'. The tax rate is a percentage
 * (20 means 20%). Tax is rounded once, on the subtotal.
 *
 * @return array subtotal, tax, total (floats rounded to 2 places)
 */
function calculate_totals(array $lines, $taxRate)
{
    $subtotal = 0;
    foreach ($lines as $line) {
        $subtotal += $line['qty'] * $line['unit_price'];
    }
    $subtotal = round($subtotal, 2);
    $tax = round($subtotal * $taxRate / 100, 2);

    return array(
        'subtotal' => $subtotal,
        'tax' => $tax,
        'total' => round($subtotal + $tax, 2),
    );
}

function sort_lines_by_sku($lines)
{
    usort($lines, create_function('$a, $b', 'return strcmp($a["sku"], $b["sku"]);'));
    return $lines;
}
